reviews.author: gopikrishna musala
reviews.text:
Dr. Deepika Madam is a very good doctor. She takes care of the patient. She listens very patiently to every question asked about the patient's health problems and answers every question.

My wife suffers from dermatomyositis and I took my wife to some doctors in Guntur and Vijayawada. They did not give any proper answers about the disease and did not give her proper treatment.

I brought my wife to the doctor in a serious condition and the doctor treated her, today she is able to walk and do her work at home.

They would also provide medicines at a lower rate, keeping in mind the financial situation of the patient

Dr. Deepika Madam is a very good doctor. My wife is alive because of that doctor.

reviews.author: vibgyoradmedia
reviews.text:
Exceptional Care Experienced here at SS Vascular and Rheumatoid Center.

I recently had the pleasure of visiting here, and I must say, I was thoroughly impressed with the level of care and professionalism I received with the Doctors here.

My consultation with Doctors here was outstanding. They took the time to listen attentively to my concerns, explained my condition clearly and provided a comprehensive treatment plan that addressed all my questions and worries.

I felt comfortable asking questions and seeking clarification on any aspects of my care.

What truly sets this Clinic apart, however, is the genuine compassion and empathy shown by the entire team. They truly care about their patients' well-being and go above and beyond to ensure that every individual receives personalized attention and support.

I highly recommend "Vascular & Rheumatology Center". My experience was nothing short of outstanding, and I feel grateful to have found such a trustworthy and caring Medical Team.

My Rating  : 5/5 Stars
